title: Pamela fails her trust test while about 70 scout craft watch
place_text: Indian Springs Valley, Nevada (ranges near the ammunition bunker)

tellings.quote: Okay. On that night, on that night, she failed the test.

plain: One night in the mid 1960s, in the desert ranges of Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, near an ammunition bunker, a being called Pamela failed a test of trust while about 70 small scout craft watched, says Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years living alongside tall white aliens at a secret Air Force base. He tells it as something he saw: "On that night, she failed the test."
